replies.text:
this absolutely blew me away.  there's so much to talk about but:
- the singing is shaped from code.  to make sure it was legible claude used a local speech -> text model to check the outputs and tweaked in a loop
- all band members actually play their instruments, frame by frame, as accurately as cartoonishly possible
- claude was literally exporting waveforms as pngs and looking at them as part of the mixing process
- there's a ton of easter eggs in the music video to find I'l l cover in another post
